parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the bandwidth plan.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The status of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

*   **init**: The bandwidth plan is being initialized.
*   **active**: The bandwidth plan is available.
*   **binded**: The bandwidth plan is associated.
*   **binding**: The bandwidth plan is being associated.
*   **unbinding**: The bandwidth plan is being disassociated.
*   **updating**: The bandwidth plan is being updated.
*   **finacialLocked**: The bandwidth plan is locked due to overdue payments.
*   **locked**: The bandwidth plan is locked.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of the bandwidth plan.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

*   **Basic**: a basic bandwidth plan
*   **CrossDomain**: a cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan

If you call this operation on the China site (aliyun.com), you can set Type only to **Basic**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-bandwidth-packages --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --state active --type Basic --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp1sgzldyj6b4q7cx0000 --resource-group-id rg-aek2ry6mp2c0000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga ListBandwidthPackages --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'tag-key' --Type Basic --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2ry6mp2c0000' --PageNumber 1 --State active --Tag.1.Value 'tag-value' --BandwidthPackageId 'gbwp-bp1sgzldyj6b4q7cx0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
